policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Preamble
(1)
La Trobe University offers work experience placements, cadetships or internships to La Trobe University undergraduate or postgraduate students who are required to undertake a work experience placement as part of their course curriculum.
(2)
The University applies the following guidelines when a placement, cadetship or internship is offered:
students undertaking cadetships or internships’ are expected to gain valuable work experience in their chosen field of study under the guidance of a nominated Manager; and
cadetships or internships’ should only be made available where students are likely to have significant opportunities to gain an understanding of work principles and practices related to their study.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Section 2 - Scope
(3)
These Procedures are applicable to persons who are undertaking a cadetship or internship at the University.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Section 3 - Policy Statement
(4)
Refer to the
Workforce Management Policy
.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
topic: Conditions of Placement, Cadetship or Internship
text:
Conditions of Placement, Cadetship or Internship
(5)
Conditions of placement, cadetship or internship include:
interns or cadets must enter into an agreement prior to the placement;
interns or cadets are to be inducted to the work area, staff and relevant safety training procedures as necessary; and
interns or cadets must arrange their own travel and accommodation where necessary for the duration of the placement.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
topic: Duration of Placement, Cadetship or Internship
text:
Duration of Placement, Cadetship or Internship
(6)
The duration of the placement, cadetship or internship should be for no longer than the maximum period as required by the curriculum of the course.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
topic: Termination of Placement, Cadetship or Internship
text:
Termination of Placement, Cadetship or Internship
(7)
The placement, cadetship or internship may be terminated at any time by either party.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Intellectual Property
(8)
All intellectual property rights developed by the intern or cadet while performing the placement, cadetship or internship are assigned to and vest in the University immediately as created. The University owns and retains all rights at all times to the University's intellectual property.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Confidentiality
(9)
The intern or cadet will keep confidential all information of the University that comes into the intern or cadet's possession.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Human Resources
(10)
Approve the engagement of an undergraduate or postgraduate student as a work experience intern or cadet.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Mentor
(11)
Responsible for the day-to-day management of the activities and supervision of the interns.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Manager
(12)
Responsible for managing the intern or cadet in their Unit, including nominating an appropriate mentor to manage the day to day activities of the intern.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Applications and Approvals
(13)
Students should submit:
a covering letter outlining:
their areas of interest
work experiences
accomplishments
a statement of the experience they hope to gain from the placement
details of the course requirements leading to the internship
resume.
(14)
Managers should:
obtain approval from People & Culture prior to accepting a cadet or intern; and
select the area that best suits the students learning needs.
(15)
Prior to the commencement of the internship, a Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Agreement and all required documentation is to be signed by relevant parties and lodged with People & Culture.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Assessment
(16)
The Manager and/or Mentor are to complete any assessment report provided by the Intern for return to the University.

policy_title: Work Experience Placement, Cadetship or Internship Procedure
text:
Section 5 - Definitions
(17)
Placement, cadetship or internship are placements at the University for a nominated period for a student to gain work experience.
(18)
Managers are responsible for managing the intern in their Unit, including nominating an appropriate mentor to manage the day to day activities of the intern.
(19)
Mentors are responsible for the day to day management of the activities and supervision of the interns.
Unit Managers include:
Deans or duly appointed delegate;
Heads of Department or duly appointed delegate;
Supervisors or duly appointed delegate; and/or
Managers or duly appointed delegate;
Work Experience includes Work placement / Cadetship / Internship.
